diagnosis: POOL workers had a binding-contract split: canonical wc and EFF030 require deterministic unified sharding for POOL, while FAST_ALLOCATION_PROTOCOL_V1 still scoped its sharding section to multi-worker BATCH only. Under a rolling pool this ambiguity can concentrate otherwise identical workers on lane-priority candidates and increase collision/low-yield pressure.
intervention: Aligned FAST_ALLOCATION_PROTOCOL_V1 with the canonical POOL contract and extended the existing sharding regression guard so EFF030 pool_sharding_enabled is asserted and the fast protocol must explicitly include POOL while excluding pools from the lane-priority fallback.
